appetizers.name: Crab Legs
appetizers.description: Fresh crab on white plate, claw crab cooking food seafood plate with lemon lime, boiled or steamed crab red in the restaurant.

appetizers.name: Buffalo Chicken Brie Bites
appetizers.description: Buffalo Chicken Brie Bites, the tangy kick of Buffalo sauce pairs wonderfully with the mellow, flavor of gooey brie cheese.

appetizers.name: Hummus, Feta and Broccoli Fritters
appetizers.description: Hummus, Feta + Broccoli Fritters — Light, cheesy, gluten-free broccoli fritters loaded with tender broccoli, creamy hummus and salty feta, served with parsley, lemon and a tangy tzatziki dip.

appetizers.name: Baked Jalapeño Poppers
appetizers.description: These jalapeño poppers are stuffed with a fresh, herbed cream cheese mixture and topped with just enough cheddar cheese to turn golden.

main.name: Herb-Crusted Roast Chicken
main.description: Free-range chicken breast roasted with rosemary, thyme, and garlic, served over creamy Yukon gold mashed potatoes with a red wine pan jus.

main.name: Pan-Seared Salmon
main.description: Atlantic salmon fillet seared to a golden crust, finished with a lemon-dill butter sauce, served alongside grilled asparagus and wild rice pilaf.

main.name: Braised Short Rib
main.description: Slow-braised beef short rib in a red wine reduction, served over creamy polenta with roasted root vegetables and crispy shallots.

main.name: Wild Mushroom Risotto
main.description: Arborio rice slow-cooked with a medley of wild mushrooms, white wine, and Parmesan, finished with truffle oil and fresh chives.

drinks.name: Elderflower Spritz
drinks.description: Prosecco, elderflower liqueur, and soda water over ice, garnished with fresh mint and a lemon twist.

drinks.name: House Red Sangria
drinks.description: A blend of red wine, brandy, orange juice, and fresh seasonal fruit, served chilled over ice.

drinks.name: Fresh Strawberry Basil Lemonade
drinks.description: House-made lemonade muddled with fresh strawberries and basil, served over ice.

drinks.name: Iced Golden Turmeric Latte
drinks.description: Espresso and steamed oat milk blended with turmeric, ginger, and a touch of honey.

desserts.name: Classic Tiramisu
desserts.description: Espresso-soaked ladyfingers layered with mascarpone cream and dusted with cocoa powder.

desserts.name: Molten Chocolate Lava Cake
desserts.description: Warm chocolate cake with a gooey molten center, served with vanilla bean ice cream and fresh berries.

desserts.name: Crème Brûlée
desserts.description: Silky vanilla bean custard topped with a torched caramelized sugar crust.

desserts.name: Affogato
desserts.description: A scoop of vanilla gelato drowned in a shot of hot espresso, finished with chocolate shavings.
